Arizona's Ultimate Backyard Builder

Creating One-of-a-Kind Outdoor Spaces

The Ultimate Backyard Experience

A Seamless Fusion of Design, Craftsmanship, & Lifestyle

The ultimate backyard is a fully customized outdoor retreat tailored to your lifestyle. Whether you dream of a resort-style pool and spa, a modern outdoor kitchen, a cozy fire pit, or a lush landscape with shaded lounging areas, we bring your vision to life with expert craftsmanship and innovative design. With decades of experience creating stunning, whole-space outdoor environments, California Pools & Landscape is your trusted partner in turning your backyard into the ultimate destination for relaxation, entertainment, and enjoyment.

Transforming Outdoor Spaces Across Arizona

We Don’t Just Build Backyards, We Build Connections

At California Pools & Landscape, we create complete outdoor living experiences designed and built under one seamless contract. Unlike other pool builders who rely on third-party landscape contractors, our expert team handles everything from pool construction and landscaping to shade structures, fire features, and hardscapes, ensuring a streamlined and stress-free process. As Arizona’s ultimate backyard builder, we are licensed, bonded, and insured across multiple categories, so you can feel confident that every detail of your outdoor transformation is in the best hands. Plus, with a dedicated project team keeping you informed and the project on schedule, you’ll save time and enjoy the process, while we bring your dream backyard to life!

Form

Your backyard should be as breathtaking as it is functional, and we design every detail with that in mind. From lush landscaping and layered lighting to sleek decking and precision-crafted features, every element works together to create a space that feels effortless and elegant. With expert craftsmanship and premium materials, your outdoor retreat will look just as stunning years from now as it does on day one.

Function

A beautiful backyard is only the beginning. We make sure it works seamlessly for your lifestyle. Smart automation lets you control lighting, water features, and more with the touch of a button, while durable materials and expert engineering ensure longevity. Whether you're hosting, unwinding, or making memories with family, your space is designed to be effortless, comfortable, and built to last.

The Elements That Shape the Ultimate Backyard

Pools

Our custom-designed pools serve as the centerpiece of every ultimate backyard. Choose from various styles and sizes, including infinity-edge designs, large family pools, and compact cocktail pools. Features like Baja shelves, swim-up bars, and integrated water features enhance functionality and luxury. Every pool is crafted precisely to complement your vision and Arizona's unique landscape.

Spas

Relax and rejuvenate with a spa tailored to your preferences. From elevated spillover designs to sleek perimeter spas and standalone acrylic options, each spa is built for comfort and elegance. Whether you're envisioning a tranquil retreat or a therapeutic hot tub, our inground spas seamlessly integrate with your backyard design.

Hardscapes

Hardscapes form your outdoor space's foundation, providing structure and style. Explore options like travertine and porcelain pavers, custom pool decks, and elegant walkways. Every element enhances usability and durability while harmonizing with your backyard’s aesthetic.

Structures

Shade and comfort are essential for Arizona living. Our custom-designed structures include pergolas, casitas, pool houses, and outdoor kitchens. Each structure is built with attention to detail, offering form and function. Choose from tiled roofs, slatted or full-coverage designs, and integrated media walls for a truly elevated experience.

Landscapes

Lush, vibrant landscaping completes your backyard transformation. Whether you prefer desert-inspired designs, tropical oases, or traditional elegance, our team curates every element, from privacy trees to colorful accents. Thoughtful touches like ambient lighting and drought-resistant plants ensure beauty and sustainability.

Ultimate Convenience

Take command of your backyard oasis with cutting-edge automation that puts luxury at your fingertips. Adjust your pool, spa, and lighting with ease right from your smartphone. Designed for convenience and built for seamless enjoyment, it’s the perfect way to elevate your outdoor living experience.

Sustainability Meets Style

Great design isn’t just about beauty. It’s about smart, sustainable solutions that make outdoor living effortless. From energy-efficient pool pumps and heating to LED lighting and drought-friendly landscaping, we create backyards that look incredible while conserving resources. Thoughtfully designed for long-term efficiency and savings, your outdoor oasis is built to be as sustainable as it is stunning.

A Backyard as Unique as You

Your backyard should be as unique as you are, crafted for relaxation, entertainment, and everyday enjoyment. From custom outdoor kitchens and water features to shaded lounges and fire elements, every detail is thoughtfully designed to fit your lifestyle. With the perfect balance of beauty and function, we create outdoor spaces that feel like home.

The Art of Outdoor Living: Real Projects, Real Impact

Peoria Ultimate Backyard

Designed for ultimate entertainment, this Peoria backyard is a showstopper from every angle. A sleek geometric perimeter overflow spa, an open water wall with a fire feature, and a stunning pool create a breathtaking focal point. The outdoor kitchen and bar, nestled under a tiled roof shade structure, provide the perfect gathering space, while a cozy fireplace adds warmth and ambiance. With its modern design and resort-style feel, this backyard is built for unforgettable moments of relaxation and entertainment.

A Seamless Blend of Home, Nature & Luxury

The Lappanos set out to transform their blank desert backyard into a stunning outdoor retreat that complemented their Scottsdale home’s natural surroundings. Inspired by breathtaking views of the Four Peaks and McDowell Mountains, our designer created a seamless extension of their home, featuring a geometric pool, elevated spa, and thoughtfully integrated landscaping. From a travertine-lined outdoor kitchen to vibrant desert plantings, every detail was designed for relaxation, entertainment, and year-round enjoyment. With a designated team managing the entire project, the Lappanos enjoyed a smooth, stress-free experience, and now have a backyard oasis they love to share with family, friends, and even their dog!

Scottsdale Sanctuary

Set against the stunning backdrop of Tom’s Thumb and the Four Peaks, this Scottsdale backyard was designed to seamlessly blend with its natural desert surroundings. Inspired by the home’s Frank Lloyd Wright influences, the geometric pool and elevated overflow spa create a striking yet harmonious focal point. Framed by 2,600 square feet of beautiful tumbled travertine, the outdoor space flows effortlessly, offering multiple areas for entertainment and relaxation. With clean lines, contemporary design, and thoughtfully integrated natural landscaping, this backyard feels like it was always meant to be part of the home.

Stress-Free from Start to Splash

For these homeowners, a backyard without water wasn’t an option, so we turned their vision into a reality. Now, every time they walk through their front door, they’re greeted by their own personal oasis, designed and built to perfection. With California Pools & Landscape handling everything from the pool to the landscaping, their dream backyard came together seamlessly in just three months. From expert craftsmanship to clear communication, they felt like they "won the lottery" with a team that delivered quality, efficiency, and a stress-free experience.

California Pools and Landscape recently completed a pool and hardscape remodel in our backyard. Theresa Campbell

What a year it was! We chose CalPools & Landscaping for their complete package, right down to the guarantee, one of the best in the industry according to our research. We were further encouraged when told that all "outside" contractors must undergo a vetting process to be able to work under the Calpools banner. We worked quite closely with all involved and key moments and people def stick out. Our designer, Christian, was fun to work with as he listened to every idea and transformed the barren backyard into our hopeful oasis in the desert right before our eyes as the measurements took shape on the screen. Seeing our dream coming to life was a tear-filled moment for sure! We had eyes on the ground through the entire process and each person and team who arrived were engaging, addressing any questions or concerns we had. From Sean, who painted the lines, to Mr Smiles who delivered ton after ton of dirt; the diggers, shockcrete, plumbers, electricians, hardscape, landscape; there were so many amazing people! The longest team on the ground was our hardscape team under Edgar/Ashton. Our design included all free-flow form; ie: lots of curves! Chava's team (Chava, Victor, Alan) were amazing! From first brick to last, every detail was considered carefully. Chava's critical eye helped to alleviate several hiccups in real time resulting in fluid perfection as travertine met pavers. When the transition from rear yard to front was waiting on HOA approval and the holidays, it was clearly understood that only Chava's team was requested to complete the full vision. Josh's team (landscape) were quite conscientious of the very real fact that placement was crucial for our vision. He even took time to meet with us at the nursery so we could hand select our plants and trees. His team lead, a very kind soul, addressed every concern and placement. He even shared that he was chosen by Josh as he is known for his patience. And patience with a smile he brought willingly! Our Forman, Stephen, was and is our first point of contact. He was always willing to address every aspect of each stage. Too many messages to count were always addressed; even after (or often before) operating hours. We consider him now a friend. Our tech who gave us the orientation was very thorough, so much so I had to record him to remember it all. All in all, as we navigate our new system and stare in awe at our beautiful Oasis in the Desert, we are so grateful to so many of the CalPool teams for helping our vision become our reality. Anyone who asks always gets a high praise recommendation to contact CalPools. Thank you CalPools! We are so very grateful and ecstatic with our Oasis! Alan & Teri Campbell Phoenix AZ

California Pools and Landscape recently completed a pool and hardscape remodel in our backyard. We understood going into this project that there were some supplier and contractor delays to be expected during this unusually busy time for pool and construction businesses. While our project took a couple of weeks longer to complete than estimated, the work was done to our total satisfaction. California Pools kept us apprised of all steps in the process, as well as time frames and dates to expect contractors to be on site. All California Pools employees we interacted with were professional, knowledgeable and willing to work with us regarding scheduling. Our project supervisor, Mark B., was always in communication with us and on site when needed. His depth of knowledge in building pools was invaluable to our project. Ashton V., our project coordinator, was always there for us whenever we called. Her communication skills and willingness to do whatever it takes to satisfy the customer are remarkable. All of the contractors involved in our project were professional, always showed up as planned and helpful at every turn. We are totally satisfied with our completed project. We would highly recommend California Pools and Landscape to anyone looking for a new pool or remodel.

Theresa Campbell

What a year it was! We chose CalPools & Landscaping for their complete package, right down to the guarantee, one of the best in the industry according to our research. We were further encouraged when told that all "outside" contractors must undergo a vetting process to be able to work under the Calpools banner. We worked quite closely with all involved and key moments and people def stick out. Our designer, Christian, was fun to work with as he listened to every idea and transformed the barren backyard into our hopeful oasis in the desert right before our eyes as the measurements took shape on the screen. Seeing our dream coming to life was a tear-filled moment for sure! We had eyes on the ground through the entire process and each person and team who arrived were engaging, addressing any questions or concerns we had. From Sean, who painted the lines, to Mr Smiles who delivered ton after ton of dirt; the diggers, shockcrete, plumbers, electricians, hardscape, landscape; there were so many amazing people! The longest team on the ground was our hardscape team under Edgar/Ashton. Our design included all free-flow form; ie: lots of curves! Chava's team (Chava, Victor, Alan) were amazing! From first brick to last, every detail was considered carefully. Chava's critical eye helped to alleviate several hiccups in real time resulting in fluid perfection as travertine met pavers. When the transition from rear yard to front was waiting on HOA approval and the holidays, it was clearly understood that only Chava's team was requested to complete the full vision. Josh's team (landscape) were quite conscientious of the very real fact that placement was crucial for our vision. He even took time to meet with us at the nursery so we could hand select our plants and trees. His team lead, a very kind soul, addressed every concern and placement. He even shared that he was chosen by Josh as he is known for his patience. And patience with a smile he brought willingly! Our Forman, Stephen, was and is our first point of contact. He was always willing to address every aspect of each stage. Too many messages to count were always addressed; even after (or often before) operating hours. We consider him now a friend. Our tech who gave us the orientation was very thorough, so much so I had to record him to remember it all. All in all, as we navigate our new system and stare in awe at our beautiful Oasis in the Desert, we are so grateful to so many of the CalPool teams for helping our vision become our reality. Anyone who asks always gets a high praise recommendation to contact CalPools. Thank you CalPools! We are so very grateful and ecstatic with our Oasis! Alan & Teri Campbell Phoenix AZ

Frequently Asked Questions About Ultimate Backyards

What services does California Pools & Landscape offer?

How do we work together?

How do I pay for my ultimate backyard?

Q: What services does California Pools & Landscape offer?

We specialize in award winning designs and the new construction of pools, spas, outdoor structures, hardscape and landscape. California Pools & Landscape is a fully licensed General Contractor that is bonded and insured to build every aspect of your backyard.

Q: How do we work together?

The first step in designing your backyard is speaking with a Customer Concierge to schedule a design consultation with a Designer. After meeting with your designer, they will create your custom design and proposal. This is a very interactive process between you and your Designer where you are reviewing, changing and finalizing project details. A contract is signed to move forward and a provided deposit allows the pre-construction process to begin.

Q: How do I pay for my ultimate backyard?

Whether you are including your contract into your first mortgage or are in need of secondary financing, California Pools & Landscape has competitive and affordable loan programs to get your project financed.

About California Pools & Landscape

Since 1988, California Pools & Landscape has been dedicated to creating exceptional outdoor spaces that bring families together. What started as a small business in a family kitchen has grown into Arizona’s ultimate backyard builder, trusted by homeowners for over 37 years. Our guiding philosophy has never changed: “What is best for the customer, is best for all of us.”

In 2021, we proudly became part of Cody Pools, the nation’s largest and most trusted pool builder. This partnership allows us to offer even greater financial stability, access to premium materials, and exclusive high-volume equipment pricing, savings that we pass directly to our customers. While we’ve expanded, our heart remains the same. We are committed to delivering a seamless, enjoyable, and rewarding experience from start to finish. Our team of experts listens, collaborates, and brings each unique backyard vision to life with exceptional craftsmanship and personalized service. At California Pools & Landscape, we don’t just build pools, we create backyards where memories are made and moments are cherished for years to come!
